elements.text:
1. prefix of the long url
2. random number generator ( 10^9 10 characters )
    - base62 encoding, 0-9, A-Z, a-z
    - 62^6 = 56B (random number between 0 - 56B)
    - Birthday Paradox
    - 880k collisions possible
    - we just need to check for collision first
3. Hash the long url
    - md5(longUrl) -> hash -> base62(hash)[:6]
    - sameAsAbove
4. Counter
    - incrementing a count -> base62 encoding
    - predictability which is bad for security
    - bijective function
        - squids.org
